records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Logistics
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Engaged admin: attended getting-started call (calendar:e4dd4b0f), created first project day 5, replied positively within a day (email:4de238da), no tickets. But no invite sent and key milestone untouched; interest in a walkthrough is vague ("at some point"), so solo activation within 8 days is plausible but uncertain.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Vantage Logistics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Glad to hear things are feeling good, and thanks for the quick reply. Happy to take you up on that walkthrough whenever it's useful.

With your first project in place, the usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time if that's easier.

Would a short call this week work? I can walk through whatever's most useful for how your team plans to use Wrenfield.

Best,
Chidi
